author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Early Access Launch trailer for Ironholm: Reign of the Isles, a medieval real-time strategy game developed by Data Innovation Lab. Expand your kingdom, raise armies, and capture new regions while commanding entire forces instead of individual soldiers. Plan your expansion, reinforce key positions, and choose the right moment to strike. Ironholm: Reign of the Isles is available now in Early Access on PC (Steam).
title: Ironholm: Reign of the Isles - Official Early Access Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the release date trailer for Sort the Creatures, a cozy sorting game developed by Orbital Fox Games. In Sort the Creatures, you sort 4800 cute, animated creatures. Pick them up, sort them into matching terrariums, and watch your colorful collection grow. Sort the Creatures will be available on PC (Steam) on November 12, 2026.
title: Sort the Creatures - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Release Date Trailer for Sooooooooooo: Strike, Scream, Run! a chaotic online multiplayer party game developed by Humita Games. In Sooooooooooo: Strike, Scream, Run! your microphone is your weapon! Use ridiculous power-ups, send your friends flying, and survive earthquakes and explosions of your rivals’ poop. Create public or private lobbies, customize your matches, and use the built-in voice chat. Sooooooooooo: Strike, Scream, Run! will be available on PC on December 4, 2026.
title: Sooooooooooo: Strike, Scream, Run! - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Aeon Aha Character Trailer for Honkai: Star Rail, a strategy RPG developed by HoYoverse. Get a look at the unpredictable, mischievous character representing laughter, humor, tragedy, and the absurd twists of fate. Honkai: Star Rail is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Honkai: Star Rail - Official Aeon Aha Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Fortnite Treasure Hunters Week 2 gameplay trailer as The Lil Uzi Crew has landed on the Island, with Buggy coming later this week. Fortnite Treasure Hunters is available now, featuring a new map, a One Piece collaboration, and more.
title: Fortnite - Official Treasure Hunters Week 2 Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gameplay Trailer for Swordeye, a PvP MMORPG dungeon-crawling game developed by ALX Theory. Players will head straight into the fray of dungeon after dungeon to extract loot, take out enemies, and master the sword in the name of survival. Swordeye is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Swordeye - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the gameplay trailer for Hear My Cult, an upcoming dark fantasy action RPG blending roguelite progression, real-time strategy, and creature collecting, developed by indie studio Frogtrain. Hear My Cult will be available on PC (Steam). A demo is out now on Steam.

Become a Cult Leader, summon and command an ever-growing army of monstrous minions, and sacrifice your own followers to unleash devastating powers. Experiment with unique creatures, discover powerful combinations through forbidden fusion rituals, and build a different army with every run.

Explore a twisted world filled with ancient gods, grotesque enemies, challenging bosses, and unsettling mysteries that extend far beyond the battlefield.

Build your Cult. Command your Army. Sacrifice Everything.
title: Hear My Cult - Official Gameplay Trailer | Endix Expo Fall 2026
